exchanges: right so i made it to glasgow in one piece, the flight from nairobi was brutal
Welcome to Scotland. Long flights are rough; did you manage to sleep at all?
not really, there was a baby screaming behind me the whole way. anyway the flat is nice, five of us sharing a kitchen
Five people in one kitchen can be lively. Have you met everyone yet?
most of them. callum seems like the flat dad already, he made a rota for the bins on day one
Every flat needs someone like that.
haha yes. he dragged me to his favourite cafe, Kokoro, its this tiny japanese place by the river and honestly the matcha was unreal
Sounds like a good find for study sessions.
the other girl aiko is lovely too, she showed me photos of her dachshund back home and i nearly cried its so cute
Pets back home are what a lot of people miss most.
for real. architecture studio started today and we have to build a model out of cardboard by friday
Studio projects move fast. What does the model have to show?
a bus shelter lol. my coursemate mehmet is in my group, hes super good at this
Good to have a strong partner on the first project.
mehmet was telling me hes Kurdish and his family moved over when he was little, and he speaks like four languages
That is an impressive range.
makes me feel lazy lol
Everyone has their own strengths, and you are only on day one.
true. my dad otieno called to check i arrived. hes stuck at work at Safaricom till late every night this month
Sounds like a busy stretch for him.
he says hi to scotland haha
Scotland says hi back.
ok so i joined netball at the sports fair, trials are next week
Good luck at trials. Did you play back home?
yeah all through school, i was goal defence
That is a demanding position.
also me and some girls from the flat are planning a trip to Edinburgh in two weeks, cheap train tickets
That is an easy trip from Glasgow.
cant wait. i wanna see the castle
The castle and the old town are worth it.
my sister wanjiru is so jealous of me being here
Maybe she can visit sometime.
she wants to come in the spring and bring Kamau, theyve been together like three years now so hes basically family
That would be a lovely visit.
i would love that. ugh my throat is killing me
Freshers week often comes with a cold. Have you seen a doctor?
went to the gp this morning, its tonsillitis, got antibiotics
Rest and fluids will help alongside the antibiotics.
callum from the flat made me soup so im fine lol
That is very kind of him.
met my personal tutor today, also called callum, i cannot escape callums
Glasgow seems to have plenty of them.
he said if we ever want to chat he basically lives at a cafe called Bramble near the library and we can just find him there
That is a relaxed way to hold office hours.
oh wait change of plans, the girls want to go to Inverness instead of edinburgh because someone has a cousin there with a spare room
That is a longer trip, but a free place to stay helps.
exactly. need to save money anyway
Budgeting in first year is a good habit.
the meal plan here doesnt exist so im living on toast
Toast is a classic. Batch cooking with your flatmates could help.
maybe. aiko can actually cook so ill bribe her
Sounds like a good trade.
i signed up for a free beginners Gaelic class at the library, figured why not since im here
That is a fun way to connect with where you are living.
wait which spot does my tutor hang out at again
thanks. ok im gonna go to bed early, throat still hurts
Rest up and feel better soon.

earlier_question.right_reply: Your tutor Callum said he is usually at Bramble.
earlier_question.wrong_reply: Your tutor Callum said he is usually at Kokoro.

which language am i gonna learn
the heating in my room is so loud lol
do you know what aiko's background is
sorry whats the cafe called, the tutor one
